responsibility: This definition file is the generated-builtin inventory for AArch64 AdvSIMD and related non-SVE vector intrinsics. It maps intrinsic families, names, mode iterators, pattern naming conventions, and attribute flags onto the backend’s builtin generator macros, allowing aarch64-builtins.cc to create declarations, function codes, attributes, and expansion mappings that correspond closely to the patterns implemented in aarch64-simd.md and neighboring machine descriptions.
